title: Reporting a Machine Problem
situation: The X-ray machine on screening line two stops and shows an error message. Alex calls Sam to report the symptom, the error text, the line, and the urgency. Sam explains what will be checked.
objective: Report a machine problem clearly: describe the symptom and error text, say which line it is on, explain why it is urgent, and confirm the next check.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Technical support. How may I help you?
dialogue.indonesian: Dukungan teknis. Ada yang bisa saya bantu?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Hello. This is Alex. I have a problem with the X-ray machine.
dialogue.indonesian: Halo. Ini Alex. Saya mengalami masalah dengan mesin X-ray.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Which line is the machine on?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: It is on screening line two, near gate B.
dialogue.indonesian: Mesin itu ada di jalur pemeriksaan dua, dekat gate B.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: What is the machine doing now?
dialogue.indonesian: Apa yang terjadi pada mesin itu sekarang?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: The belt stops again and again, and the screen shows an error message.
dialogue.indonesian: Belt-nya berhenti berulang kali, dan layar menampilkan pesan error.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: What does the error message say?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: It says BELT JAM. The letters are in red.
dialogue.indonesian: Pesannya BELT JAM. Huruf-hurufnya berwarna merah.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: No. The belt is not moving now.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Is this urgent for your operation?
dialogue.indonesian: Apakah ini mendesak untuk operasi Anda?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Yes. It is urgent because passengers are waiting. What should I check next?
dialogue.indonesian: Ya. Ini mendesak karena penumpang sedang menunggu. Apa yang harus saya periksa selanjutnya?

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Please follow the official SOP. I will check the belt sensor log and call you back.
dialogue.indonesian: Mohon ikuti SOP resmi. Saya akan memeriksa log sensor belt dan menelepon Anda kembali.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Understood. I will wait for your call. Thank you.
dialogue.indonesian: Baik. Saya akan menunggu telepon Anda. Terima kasih.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Goodbye, Alex. Call us if anything changes.
dialogue.indonesian: Selamat tinggal, Alex. Hubungi kami jika ada perubahan.

keyExpressions.english: I have a problem with the X-ray machine.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Saya mengalami masalah dengan mesin X-ray.
keyExpressions.note: Gunakan have a problem with untuk menyebut masalah.

keyExpressions.english: It is on screening line two, near gate B.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Mesin itu ada di jalur pemeriksaan dua, dekat gate B.
keyExpressions.note: Sebutkan jalur dan lokasi dengan jelas.

keyExpressions.english: The belt stops again and again, and the screen shows an error message.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Belt-nya berhenti berulang kali, dan layar menampilkan pesan error.
keyExpressions.note: again and again menunjukkan masalah yang berulang.

keyExpressions.english: What does the error message say?
keyExpressions.note: Gunakan does untuk pertanyaan dengan he, she, atau it.
Baca pesan error persis seperti yang tertulis.

keyExpressions.english: Is this urgent for your operation?
keyExpressions.indonesian: Apakah ini mendesak untuk operasi Anda?

keyExpressions.english: I will check the belt sensor log and call you back.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Saya akan memeriksa log sensor belt dan menelepon Anda kembali.

keyExpressions.note: SOP adalah prosedur resmi di lokasi kerja.

sentencePatterns.pattern: I have a problem with + noun.
sentencePatterns.explanation: Menyebutkan masalah dengan mesin atau perangkat.
examples: I have a problem with the X-ray machine.
I have a problem with the display unit.
It is on screening line two, near gate B.
It is on the check-in line near door four.
What does the error message say?

sentencePatterns.pattern: I will check + noun + and call you back.
sentencePatterns.explanation: Menyebutkan pemeriksaan berikutnya dan janji menelepon kembali.
examples: I will check the belt sensor log and call you back.
I will check the machine record and call you back.

learningNotes: Sebutkan gejala yang terlihat dan terdengar, bukan hanya kata “rusak”.
Baca pesan error persis seperti yang tertulis di layar.
Jelaskan apakah masalahnya mendesak dan sebutkan dampaknya pada operasi.

pronunciationNotes.title: urgent
pronunciationNotes.note: Tekanan ada di suku kata pertama: UR-jent (/ˈɜːrdʒənt/).
